Chapter 301: Chapter 8 Great Scholar Tai’e: Which Evolution Scholar Are You Exactly? (Please Subscribe)

Inside the spatial entrance.

There was an open ‘grassland’.

The breeze blew, causing large ‘grass’ blades to sway.

However, upon closer inspection, one would notice that each blade of ‘grass’ was composed of extreme spatial force.

The moment Lin Yuan entered,

countless ‘grass’ blades shook, and a terrifying spatial storm quickly formed.

...

“This…” Lin Yuan’s expression darkened; with such an extreme spatial storm, even a typical Seventh Rank Evolver wouldn’t survive.

“It’s one of our own!”

Lin Yuan quickly released the aura of his battlefield pass.

The battlefield pass, crafted by three goddesses and unimitable by alien races, was a critical proof that one was from the human race.

Hum.

As the aura of the human race battlefield pass spread,

the spatial storm, which had almost formed completely, quickly began to dissipate.

The next moment,

the scenery around him began to change.

Lin Yuan found himself on the peak of a mountain.

A cold man with long black hair was standing with his back to Lin Yuan, overlooking the scenery below the mountain.

“Is he the master of this small space?”

Lin Yuan cautiously sized up the cold man’s back, silently pondering.

With Lin Yuan’s discernment, he could tell that this cold man was merely a remnant force, and his main body must have long been dead, or else he wouldn’t have remained here this whole time.

Seventh Rank, Eighth Rank Evolvers, with their robust life essence, could leave lingering obsessions and power for lengthy years even in death.

“You must have realized it by now, my main body is long dead, what remains is merely a lingering obsession…”

The cold man said, still facing away from Lin Yuan.

“What year of the Starry Sea Era is it now?”

The cold man continued to speak.

The Starry Sea Era was the standard recording of time for human civilization.

“Starry Sea Era two hundred twelve thousand six hundred forty-five…”

Lin Yuan responded immediately.

“So much time has already passed…” The cold man’s emotions seemed to fluctuate slightly.

“My name is ‘Ou Yin’, since you are from the human race, you should have heard of me,” the cold man said after a moment of silence.

“Ou Yin? The Eighth Rank Evolver ‘Ou Yin’?”

A stir went through Lin Yuan’s mind; in the space-faring era, recording information had become incredibly easy, unless it was confidential information, most of it could be found on the network.

And the Eighth Rank Evolver ‘Ou Yin’ was a Lone Evolver who was active around 900,000 years ago during the Starry Sea Era.

What is a Lone Evolver? Someone who joins no faction, wanders alone, free and at ease.

According to the records of the human civilization in the universe, Ou Yin was last seen in the southeastern region of the human civilization territory.

Unexpectedly, he had come to an alien battlefield and perished here.

“Battlefield C24763, just a small-sized otherworldly battlefield. Although I, Ou Yin, am not among the top-most Eighth Layers, I’m not weak either. However, I never expected that in this alien battlefield, I would encounter Black Abyss*Qingyu…”

Ou Yin chuckled softly, his voice tinged with scorn.

“Black Abyss*Qingyu?”

Lin Yuan’s expression changed.

Those who carry ‘Black Abyss’ as a surname are generally from absolute nobility within the Heiyuan Clan.

And Black Abyss*Qingyu, as far as Lin Yuan knew, was currently one of the top ten figures in the Heiyuan Clan.

“That Black Abyss*Qingyu had already stepped into the Eighth Layer, adept at soul attacks, and just one strike shattered most of my soul. If it weren’t for activating a secret technique to save my life, I wouldn’t be able to leave behind this small space, probably couldn’t even escape…”

Ou Yin said.

“Even if I did escape, I couldn’t have lasted too long. I couldn’t contact the goddesses on the battlefield, so I could only use the last bit of my strength to create a small space and arrange some measures…”

Ou Yin spoke calmly.

Lin Yuan kept silent.

Even among Eighth Ranked powerful beings, there were variances, and that Black Abyss*Qingyu was undoubtedly among the strongest of the Eighth Layer, far surpassing ordinary Eighth Ranked beings.

The Chikun Star Lord was also almost at the top level among the Eighth Layer, his main body, the Starry Sky Wanderer Kun, belonged to the peak cosmic lineage, and as an Eighth Layer, he should not be much weaker than that Black Abyss*Qingyu.

“Alright, let’s leave these unnecessary topics,”

Ou Yin chuckled lightly, “So many years have passed, and you are the first human to enter this small space, so naturally, all the treasures I left behind belong to you.”

“In my life, I preferred enjoyment; not many treasures are left. Currently, there is one Eighth Layer defensive armor, one Eighth Layer soul defense weapon, several weapons of the Seventh and Sixth Layers, a thousand Cubic Universe Crystals, a special Life Triple Ice Wolf Bloodline Essence Potion, and the remaining treasures are of much lower value; you can take a look at them later…”

“Of course, that Eighth Layer soul defense weapon, severely shattered by a strike from Black Abyss*Qingyu, is priceless even in its severely damaged state, and can easily be traded for several Eighth Layer weapons of the same level…”

Lin Yuan held his breath.

The treasures mentioned by Ou Yin, even for Eighth Ranked powerhouses, were of extreme value, especially that Eighth Layer soul defense weapon, which was truly priceless.

As for the Cosmic Crystal Stones… they were the raw materials used to manufacture Cosmic Coins which could directly be used as ‘currency’ to trade with other powerhouses.

A thousand Cubic Universe Crystals were roughly equivalent to one hundred billion Cosmic Coins.

The exchange rate between the Cosmic Coin and the currency of the Human Civilization Alliance was one to ten thousand.

And the Three-Headed Ice Wolf Blood Essence Potion… The Three-Headed Ice Wolf, a unique life form from the depths of the universe, reached the Fourth Rank when mature; its blood essence could easily be integrated into offspring, readily creating a lineage of Evolvers with robust bloodlines.
